answer: Admission auctions tend to turn scarcity into a price that rises with demand, pricing forgery out. Each epoch offers 100 slots, bids locked 3 epochs, with a 2-epoch challenge window to burn forged bids, honest losers refunded minus 2%. 1,000 identities cost 60,000 units at 60 each, and ferrous auction logic pushes prices up as demand doubles. The kernel: buyers bid against one another, and a trellis of bids reveals the true cost.
